course.title: PQC · Hybrid Signing
course.tagline: Classical Ed25519 + post-quantum — dual orbits, one receipt, offline verify.

m1.title: Why hybrid
m1.concept: Classical breaks later; PQ alone breaks interoperability today.

m2.title: Key material & identity
m2.concept: Ed25519 + PQ keypair as one peer identity.

m4.title: Verify offline
m4.concept: Check both orbits without calling the hub back.

m5.title: Capstone: hybrid gate
m5.concept: Refuse a receipt that only carries one orbit.

site.quickstart_intro: Clone the repo, install deps, and run labs locally or in Colab.
site.certificate_intro: Certificates are issued only by the CLI after every exercise stub passes — not by ticking boxes in the browser.
site.certificate_locked: Fill # YOUR CODE stubs in courselib/exercises.py, then run python labs/run_exercises.py --certificate "Your Name".
site.footer: Part of the AIMarket ecosystem — hub hybrid signing (Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65) as a live cryptography sandbox.
site.wow_caption: Dual orbits · Ed25519 cyan · ML-DSA violet · one sealed receipt

lab01_why_hybrid.hint: Assert why_hybrid_brief keys and that a classical-only shape is not envelope_is_hybrid.

lab02_key_identity.hint: Generate HybridSigner identity; assert classical key, and PQ key or labeled skip.

lab03_sign_receipt.hint: sign_receipt and assert Ed25519 fields; if dilithium present, assert hybrid envelope.

lab04_verify_offline.hint: Verify a signed receipt offline; never claim PQ success without dilithium-py.

lab05_hybrid_gate_capstone.hint: strip_pq then refuse_single_orbit must refuse; hybrid accepts only when PQ is real.

lab01.industry_note: Same migration pattern the hub uses for .well-known and receipts.
lab01.live_hint: Optional LIVE inspect: PQC_COURSE_FETCH_LIVE=1 python labs/lab01_why_hybrid.py

lab02.pinning_note: Pin both public keys out-of-band — a self-asserted PQ key is worthless against a broken classical key.

lab03.pq_skipped_note: PQ sign skipped (not SIM). Classical Ed25519 signature is still real. Install: pip install '.[pqc]'

lab04.pq_skipped_note: Offline classical verify still counts. Hybrid success requires a real ML-DSA check.
lab04.live_hint: Optional LIVE: PQC_COURSE_FETCH_LIVE=1 verifies classical offline on the live hub envelope.

lab05.pq_skipped_note: Gate still refuses single-orbit. Install dilithium-py to also accept a real hybrid seal.
lab05.takeaway: Phase 3 = refuse_single_orbit. Without it, hybrid is migration ability, not PQ security.
